title: CoreWeave Partners with CrowdStrike to Secure AI Workloads | CrowdStrike
summary: CoreWeave partners with CrowdStrike to secure mission-critical AI workloads with Falcon protection, 24/7 threat hunting, and managed detection.
body_markdown:
*Falcon brings industry-leading protection, 24/7 threat hunting, and managed detection and response to the AI cloud powering the world's most demanding workloads*


**AUSTIN, Texas; Livingston, N.J.; Fal.Con Europe 2026, Barcelona – November 2, 2026 –**[CrowdStrike](https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/) (NASDAQ: CRWD) and[CoreWeave](https://www.coreweave.com/) (NASDAQ: CRWV), The Essential Cloud for AI™, today announced an expanded strategic partnership to secure production AI at scale. CoreWeave is bringing[CrowdStrike Falcon® platform](https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/platform/) protection and 24/7 managed security expertise to customers running mission-critical AI workloads on its cloud, making industry-leading cybersecurity foundational to production AI.


"Production AI is becoming mission-critical, and adversaries know it," said Daniel Bernard, chief business officer at CrowdStrike. "CoreWeave powers some of the world's most advanced AI. CrowdStrike secures where it runs. Together, we're bringing the same protection trusted by the world's leading enterprises to the AI cloud platform powering the AI revolution, delivered at the source."


"The world's most demanding AI workloads require a platform built for performance, scale, and security," said Jon Jones, chief revenue officer at CoreWeave. "Security is engineered into CoreWeave Cloud from the ground up. By bringing CrowdStrike Falcon protection and 24/7 managed security expertise to our cloud, we're giving customers the security they need to move AI into production with confidence. Our work with CrowdStrike, including supporting SafeMind training and inference, reflects a shared commitment to advancing both AI infrastructure and cybersecurity."


**Securing Production AI with the Falcon Platform**


The new joint offering brings together four key capabilities to protect mission-critical AI workloads:


-


**Real-time Protection for AI Workloads:**[Falcon Cloud Security](https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/platform/cloud-security/) delivers visibility and protection across cloud workloads, containers, and GPU clusters to identify and stop threats targeting production AI environments.


-


**Proactive, Around-the-clock Threat Hunting:**[Falcon Adversary OverWatch](https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/platform/threat-intelligence/adversary-overwatch/) provides 24/7 expert threat hunting to uncover sophisticated adversaries targeting mission-critical AI workloads and intellectual property.


-


**Fully Managed Detection and Response:**[Falcon Complete Cloud Security](https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/resources/data-sheets/falcon-complete-cloud-security/) delivers 24/7 managed detection and response, from investigation and containment through full remediation, reducing the burden on security teams.


-


**Expert Support:** CrowdStrike Elite Support provides dedicated expertise to help customers maintain protection across their AI environments.


**Powering the Next Generation of Cyber AI with CrowdStrike SafeMind** Building on their partnership to[power the secure AI cloud](https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/press-releases/crowdstrike-coreweave-partner-to-power-secure-ai-cloud/) , CoreWeave provides the high-performance AI platform supporting the training and inference for[CrowdStrike SafeMind](https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/press-releases/crowdstrike-launches-frontier-models-for-cybersecurity-with-nvidia/) , CrowdStrike’s family of purpose-built security models and harnesses.


**About CrowdStrike**
[CrowdStrike](https://www.crowdstrike.com/) (NASDAQ: CRWD), a global cybersecurity leader, has redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced cloud-native platform for protecting critical areas of enterprise risk – endpoints and cloud workloads, identity and data.


Powered by the CrowdStrike Security Cloud and world-class AI, the CrowdStrike Falcon® platform leverages real-time indicators of attack, threat intelligence, evolving adversary tradecraft, and enriched telemetry from across the enterprise to deliver hyper-accurate detections, automated protection and remediation, elite threat hunting, and prioritized observability of vulnerabilities.


Purpose-built in the cloud with a single lightweight-agent architecture, the Falcon platform delivers rapid and scalable deployment, superior protection and performance, reduced complexity, and immediate time-to-value.
